name: agreement-statement
title: Draft agreement performance statement
for_each: select id,name from agreements  order by ends_on

sections.title: Agreement record
sections.note: Internal working document. Verify the signed agreement before sharing. Actual value means quantity multiplied by schedule price, not recognised revenue or an invoice.

sections.title: Scheduled products
sections.sql: select product,starts_on,ends_on,unit,planned,actual,gap,currency,planned_value,actual_value,actuals_freshness from schedule_performance where agreement_id=$1 order by starts_on

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.sql: select name,owner,due_on,state,resolution from followups where agreement_id=$1 order by due_on

name: renewal-brief

for_each: select id,name from agreements where status in ('Active','Approved') and ends_on<=current_date+60 order by ends_on
